title: Nizza Menu Cover · Bespoke specification
description: Nizza combines a substantial main section with a separately changeable page for recommendations. Content is held on the right in a ring mechanism or as a folded section, while pockets on the left present daily specials. Capacity for up to one hundred pages, standard or custom sizes, variable pockets, padding, stitching, corners and branding make the cover highly flexible.

body.html: Screen colours are indicative. Colour, finish and availability are agreed against physical samples for your approval.
Production can take 4–6 weeks after your approval. We agree the specific delivery date with you.
Where the product, materials and capacity allow, express orders are available for a surcharge, with delivery potentially in under two weeks. We confirm feasibility before you place the order.
For new customers, we request 100% payment in advance. For large orders from existing customers, we request a 50% advance payment. The agreed terms are set out in your quotation.
